name: search-plus-plus
description: Unified popup search for files, folders, text, symbols, usages and commands. Inspired by JetBrains IDEs.

searchPlusPlus.showEverythingTab.description: Show the combined Everything tab. Turning this off leaves the individual source tabs available.

searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources.description: Choose the search types available in the popup. Each checked type appears as its own tab and as a group in Everything. Unchecking hides both. Keep at least one type checked.

searchPlusPlus.tabOrder.markdownDescription: **Drag rows** to set the tab order. Everything uses the same order for its result groups. Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` to show or hide sources. Unselected sources keep their positions; missing tabs are appended automatically.

searchPlusPlus.whenSearchOpens.description: Choose the tab shown when opening search++. Last used tab remembers your last tab in this workspace. If that tab is hidden, the first visible tab opens.

enumDescriptions: Add no preset shortcuts. Your custom keybindings, Double Shift, and shortcuts inside the popup stay available. Switching back to this option disables the preset bindings.

Open search++ instead of VS Code search: Files with Cmd+P / Ctrl+P; workspace Symbols with Cmd+T / Ctrl+T; Text with Cmd+Shift+F / Ctrl+Shift+F; Commands with Cmd+Shift+P / Ctrl+Shift+P. Keys are macOS / Windows & Linux.

Open search++ with IntelliJ-style keys: Files with Cmd+Shift+O / Ctrl+Shift+N; workspace Symbols with Cmd+O / Ctrl+N; Text with Cmd+Shift+F / Ctrl+Shift+F; Commands with Cmd+Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A. Keys are macOS / Windows & Linux.
searchPlusPlus.shortcutPreset.markdownDescription:
Redirect the shortcuts below to search++. Each shortcut opens the named tab. Keys are shown as **macOS / Windows & Linux**.

- **Files:** VS Code `Cmd+P` / `Ctrl+P`; IntelliJ `Cmd+Shift+O` / `Ctrl+Shift+N`.
- **Workspace symbols:** VS Code `Cmd+T` / `Ctrl+T`; IntelliJ `Cmd+O` / `Ctrl+N`.
- **Text:** Both presets use `Cmd+Shift+F` / `Ctrl+Shift+F`.
- **Commands:** VS Code `Cmd+Shift+P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P`; IntelliJ `Cmd+Shift+A` / `Ctrl+Shift+A`.

**Keep existing shortcuts** adds no preset bindings; choosing it again disables the preset. Your custom keybindings are kept. **Double Shift** and shortcuts inside the popup are independent of this setting. **F1** still opens VS Code's Command Palette.

[Edit individual search++ shortcuts](command:workbench.action.openGlobalKeybindings?%5B%22%40ext%3Aexpiracy.search-plus-plus%22%5D). User keybindings take priority over presets. Keymap extensions may claim the same keys; use the Keyboard Shortcuts editor to resolve conflicts.

searchPlusPlus.enabledSearches.description: Choose what you can search. Each enabled type appears as a tab and inside Everything. Keep at least one search type enabled.
searchPlusPlus.enabledSearches.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.searchOrder.markdownDescription: **Drag rows** to arrange tabs and Everything groups. Disabled searches keep their position and are skipped. Missing entries are appended automatically.
searchPlusPlus.searchOrder.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.tabs.markdownDescription: Tabs shown in the search popup. **Drag rows to reorder.** Remove a tab to hide it; choose **Add Item** to show it again. Keep at least one tab. Direct search commands can still open hidden tabs.
searchPlusPlus.tabs.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.defaultMode.description: Opening tab when Remember Last Mode is off. If hidden, the first visible tab opens. Direct search commands still open their requested tab.
searchPlusPlus.defaultMode.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.whenSearchOpens#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.rememberLastMode.description: Reopen the last-used tab when it is visible. Otherwise use Default Mode. Direct search commands open their requested tab.
searchPlusPlus.rememberLastMode.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.whenSearchOpens#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.visibleTabs.description: Tabs shown in the popup. Keep at least one tab visible. Direct search commands can still open hidden tabs.
searchPlusPlus.visibleTabs.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.resultsPerSearchType.markdownDescription: Maximum results returned for each search type: Files, Folders, Text, Symbols or Commands. On Everything, each group also has its own display limit: `#searchPlusPlus.resultsPerEverythingGroup#`.

searchPlusPlus.resultsPerEverythingGroup.markdownDescription: Maximum results displayed per source group on the Everything tab. Use the more-results row to open the full source tab. A group cannot show more than `#searchPlusPlus.resultsPerSearchType#`.

searchPlusPlus.searchDelay.description: Delay after typing, in milliseconds, for the Text, Symbols and Commands tabs. Symbols and Commands inside Everything use the same delay; Files, Folders and Everything text results start immediately.

searchPlusPlus.gitIgnoreRules.description: Hide files and folders matched by .gitignore by default. The Gitignore toggle in the search popup can temporarily include them.

searchPlusPlus.searchIgnoreRules.description: Hide files and folders matched by .searchignore by default. The Search-ignore toggle in the search popup can temporarily include them.

searchPlusPlus.excludedPaths.description: Always hide matching files and folders using glob patterns, for example **/dist/** or **/*.min.js. These exclusions also apply when ignore-file filters are switched off.

searchPlusPlus.excludeGitIgnored.description: Hide files and folders matched by .gitignore by default. The Gitignore toggle in the search popup can temporarily include them.
searchPlusPlus.excludeGitIgnored.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.gitIgnoreRules#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.excludeSearchIgnored.description: Hide files and folders matched by .searchignore by default. The Search-ignore toggle in the search popup can temporarily include them.
searchPlusPlus.excludeSearchIgnored.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.searchIgnoreRules#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.excludePaths.description: Always hide matching files and folders using glob patterns, for example **/dist/** or **/*.min.js. These exclusions also apply when ignore-file filters are switched off.
searchPlusPlus.excludePaths.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.excludedPaths#`. Existing choices are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to display per search mode
searchPlusPlus.maxResults.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.resultsPerSearchType#`. Existing values are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.everywhere.resultLimit.description: Maximum results shown per section on the Everything tab
searchPlusPlus.everywhere.resultLimit.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.resultsPerEverythingGroup#`. Existing values are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before triggering search
searchPlusPlus.debounceMs.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.searchDelay#`. Existing values are converted automatically.

searchPlusPlus.everything.sources.description: Choose which sources appear on the Everything tab. Tick a source to include it; untick it to hide it.
searchPlusPlus.everything.sources.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#` under Search popup. Tabs and Everything share these choices.

searchPlusPlus.everything.order.markdownDescription: Optional order of groups on the Everything tab. **Drag rows to reorder.** Use `#searchPlusPlus.everything.sources#` to show or hide sources. Missing sources appear last.
searchPlusPlus.everything.order.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#` under Search popup. Tabs and Everything share these choices.

searchPlusPlus.everywhere.sections.markdownDescription: Sections shown on the Everything tab. Array order controls display order. Remove a section to hide it.
searchPlusPlus.everywhere.sections.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#searchPlusPlus.everythingTabSources#` and `#searchPlusPlus.tabOrder#` under Search popup. Tabs and Everything share these choices.
